item.title: Abasi 5% EC
item.description: Abasi 5% EC Insecticide and Miticide Abasi 5% EC is an abamectin insecticide and miticide for growers of roses and vegetables. It controls thrips and spider mites, and it can be used as a dip to control nematodes on roses. It also protects tomatoes against spider mites and caterpillars, cucumbers against leaf miners and aphids, and French beans against leaf miners, thrips, spider mites and aphids. ACTIVE INGREDIENT Abamectin 5%, in an emulsifiable concentrate (EC) formulation. WHY GROWERS CHOOSE ABASI 5% EC • Highly effective against mites and leaf-mining insects, with strong knockdown action • Works by contact and stomach activity, so pests stop feeding quickly • Translaminar movement protects both the upper and lower leaf surfaces • Reliable control of thrips and other small sucking pests • Effective at low use rates, which keeps the cost per hectare down CROPS AND PESTS • Roses: thrips and spider mites, and nematodes when used as a dip • Tomatoes: spider mites and caterpillars • Cucumbers: leaf miners and aphids • French beans: leaf miners, thrips, spider mites and aphids HOW TO MIX Half fill the spray tank with water. Add the required amount of Abasi 5EC, then top up with water to the required level and mix or agitate thoroughly until uniform. Spray immediately after mixing. The application rate for this product is 200 to 300 ml per hectare in 1000 litres of water. HOW IT WORKS Abamectin activates glutamate-gated chloride channels in the pest, increasing chloride ion flow and causing paralysis. This is why treated mites and insects stop feeding soon after they contact or eat the spray. SAFETY Always read the label before use and follow the pre-harvest interval for your crop. Wear protective clothing, gloves, a mask and eye protection when mixing and spraying. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Do not let spray or rinse water reach streams or ponds. item.title: Zagro Ultraxide Disinfectant for Poultry & Livestock Farms
item.description: ZAGRO Ultraxide Disinfectant 1 Litre for Poultry and Livestock Farms Buy Zagro Ultraxide Disinfectant online in Kenya. Why Farmers Choose Ultraxide • Effective against all 17 virus families affecting man and animals • Strong action on bacteria, protozoa (coccidia), mycoplasma (CRD), moulds and fungi • Active in the presence of organic matter • Cleans and disinfects in one step • Non-corrosive and non-tainting, with no environmental residues • Pleasant smell, with residual activity of up to 2 weeks • Suitable for farms, hatcheries and processing plants • Can be used as an aerial spray (fumigation of animal houses) • A safe, effective water sterilant How to Use • Surface disinfection: 25 ml per 10 L water, applied at 300 ml/m² • Foot and wheel baths: 100 ml per 10 L water (replace every 2 weeks) • Drinking water: 10 ml per 30 L water, twice weekly or continuously if necessary Available sizes: 50 ml, 100 ml, 500 ml, 1 L and 5 L. Biosecurity Tips for Poultry and Livestock Farms Disease prevention is cheaper than treatment. item.title: Absolute 375SC Systemic Fungicide (Greenlife) 1 Litre
item.description: Absolute 375SC Systemic Fungicide by Greenlife Crop Protection Africa Absolute 375SC is a systemic fungicide that protects crops before infection and treats diseases already on the plant. It combines three active ingredients in one product: Azoxystrobin 200 g/L, Difenoconazole 125 g/L and Hexaconazole 50 g/L. Together they give broad disease control on vegetables, fruit trees, cereals and ornamentals. WHY FARMERS CHOOSE ABSOLUTE 375SC • Three active ingredients in one product for broad disease control • Preventive and curative action • Absorbed by the plant and moves quickly through it, so protection reaches new growth • Suitable for vegetables, fruit trees, cereals and ornamentals • Genuine Greenlife product HOW IT PROTECTS YOUR CROP Fungal diseases can spread fast in warm, humid weather. Because Absolute 375SC is systemic, the active ingredients are taken into the leaf and carried through the plant rather than sitting only on the surface. This means the product can stop an infection that has already started and also protect leaves from new infection. Using three different active ingredients also supports resistance management compared with relying on a single one. WHEN TO USE IT Start your spray programme early, before disease is widespread, and keep scouting your crop. Preventive sprays work best when disease pressure is rising, for example after prolonged leaf wetness or heavy dews. If you already see spots, mildew or rust, spray promptly, because curative action works best on early infections. PACK SIZES 50 ml | 100 ml | 250 ml | 1 L Choose the size that matches your acreage. Small packs suit kitchen gardens and trial plots, while the 1 litre pack suits commercial growers and larger farms. HOW TO USE Always follow the dosage and pre-harvest interval on the product label. Wear protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and keep out of reach of children. Spray in calm weather, early morning or late afternoon, and do not spray if rain is expected soon. Do not let spray or rinse water reach streams, ponds or fish. STORAGE Keep in the original closed container in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. ORDER Order Absolute 375SC fungicide online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to your farm anywhere in Kenya, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.

item.description: Buy the Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with a 6-way extension socket online in Kenya. Power cuts, sudden returns of electricity and low voltage are some of the most common reasons fridge compressors fail. This guard sits between your wall socket and your fridge or freezer, watches the supply, and cuts the power when it is unsafe so your appliance is not damaged. How it works: the guard has three indicator lights marked OFF, WAIT and ON. When the supply is unsafe it disconnects the appliance.
